emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: hazard report during cleaning and preparation on P-4104

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.

Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the secondary containment by bund and drainage on P-4104, HX-4120 and PT-4104 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. P-4104 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 23 January 2011 a hazard report was recorded on P-4104, HX-4120 and PT-4104 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during cleaning and preparation; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
